## Checklist

- [ ] `npm ci && npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/eolent/eolent/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] A change to the manifest schema has an ADR or a changelog entry in `spec/README.md`
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data
